values.note: $7 a night for a single site (standard or equestrian); $14 for the double site and the group site.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145521/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: PeakStandardNightly 7, PeakEquestrianNightly 7, PeakDoublesiteNightly 14, PeakGroupEquestrianNightly 14) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/woods-ferry-recreation-area ('Single Site: $7 per night / Group Site: $14 per night'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Forest Service (Enoree Ranger District) campground. Every site is reservation-only on recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777, same-day reservations included; have a reservation before arrival and clip it to the site post. 14 nights in any 30 days (Forest Order FM-19-01).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/woods-ferry-recreation-area ('All sites are available by reservation only. Make reservations online at Recreation.gov or by calling 1-877-444-6777'; 'Ensure you have a reservation for your campsite before arrival') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145521 (notice 'All sites available with same day reservations'; 'Forest Order No. FM-19-01: Prohibits camping in excess of 14 days within any 30-day time period'; rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/woods-ferry-recreation-area ('Woods Ferry Campground is open year-round'; Seasons of Use 'Open year-round'; status 'Site Open'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145521 ('There is “NO WATER OR ELECTRICAL HOOK-UPS” available'; notice 'No Electrical or Water Hookups available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 15 single sites, one double and one group site; 12 are equestrian (10 with corrals). The four standard sites are 11, 13, 14 and 15 (driveways 30-45 ft; 11 and 13 list RVs); double site 09 is a 60-ft pull-through. Gravel road and spurs that vary in size and grade: 'Not all sites can accommodate all sizes of campers'.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/woods-ferry-recreation-area ('15 single campsites, one double campsite and one group campsite. The campground road is gravel with gravel parking spurs. Campsite parking spurs vary in size and grade. Not all sites can accommodate all sizes of campers and camper vehicles') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145521 ('10 campsites have horse corrals') + RIDB campsite catalog for 10145521 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json) (4 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites 11/13/14/15, driveways 35/40/30/45; 12 EQUESTRIAN NONELECTRIC + 1 GROUP EQUESTRIAN; Pull-through on 05 and 09), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Water spigots throughout the campground (no bathing or dishwashing at them); vault toilets at both ends. Cell coverage is unreliable.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/woods-ferry-recreation-area ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145521 ('Water spigots are centrally located throughout the campground'; 'Vault toilets are centrally located to both ends of the campground'; notice 'The campground doesn’t provide a dump station' and 'cell coverage is unreliable'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS Sumter NF (Enoree RD) recreation area on the east bank of the Broad River, about a two-tenths-mile walk from the campground to the picnic area and the river. Gravel campground road; some spurs fit a standard RV. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (Enoree RD), not a concession. Confirmed $7/night single sites ($14 double/group), reservation-only on recreation.gov incl. same day (never first-come), year-round, no hookups, 17 sites (12 equestrian), vault toilets, spigot water, no dump; added 14-night limit (Forest Order FM-19-01) and pull-through (double site 09). FS alerts (bridge 251H, Litchfield, FSR 301 Worthys Ferry, Clark's Creek Rd, Candy Branch range) name no closure on Park Rd (S-12-574) or Woods Ferry Rd (S-12-49). Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: booking window, max rig length.
